Hangul shaper: jamo composition/decomposition and tone reordering.

Ported from harfrust ot/shaper/hangul.rs. Precomposed LV/LVT syllables compose when the font has the glyph, otherwise the syllable decomposes and ljmo/vjmo/tjmo features apply to the jamo; a following tone mark moves before the syllable unless it is zero-width. calt is kept away from jamo (some fonts route jamo lookups through it).

    forbids: [].}
